title: GOD OF MOSES, ARISE AND PART EVERY RED SEA BEFORE ME!
text: Lift your hands wherever you are and give thanks to the Ancient of Days. Say, "Father, you are the same yesterday, today, and forever. You were the God of Moses, and you are still the God of miracles." Exodus 14:13, "Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will show to you today. For the Egyptians whom you have seen today, you shall see them again no more forever." Tonight, that verse becomes your verdict. The God who parted seas still opens impossibilities. His arm has not grown weak. His covenant has not expired. Every Red Sea represents a limit, that invisible line between promise and possession. You know it's there when effort stops working, when options run out, when enemies laugh louder than prayers. But the same voice that told Moses, "Stretch forth your rod," still thunders to generations. Lift your voice and declare, "God of Moses, arise. Every Red Sea before me, part." Father, we magnify you. You divided waters. You silenced pharaohs. You made a path where logic ended. Psalm 77:14, "Thou art the God that doest wonders. Thou has declared thy strength among the people." Declare his strength now. Tell the sea who your God is. The sea does not part because of shouting. It parts because of revelation. Beloved, the word is your rod. Every time you speak it in faith, the waters recognize authority. Hebrews 4:12, "For the word of God is quick and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword." So, tonight we lift that sword against every blockade. Father, by your word, tear open barriers. Let spiritual walls crumble. Let administrative doors open. Let generational patterns collapse. Every destiny here, caught between prophecy and manifestation, receives passage. Isaiah 43:16, "Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters." You are that same Lord. Do it again. Say aloud, "The Lord makes a way for me." In business, IN FAMILY, IN HEALTH, IN DESTINY, NO BARRIER IS eternal when God arises. And the spirit of the Lord says, "Do not fear the sea, fear unbelief." Unbelief builds invisible chains that are stronger than pharaoh's chariots, BUT FAITH TURNS SILENCE into songs. Exodus 15:1, "Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord. I will sing unto the Lord, for he HATH TRIUMPHED GLORIOUSLY." THE SAME MOUTH THAT ONCE CRIED in fear became an instrument of worship. FATHER, TURN CRIES into choruses tonight. LET TEARS BECOME TESTIMONIES. LET HEARTS THAT ONCE DOUBTED OVERFLOW with gratitude. Now decree, "Every Red Sea before me, career Red Sea, financial Red Sea, relational Red Sea, HEAR THE VOICE OF THE LORD, PART." THE wind of the spirit is blowing eastward. Exodus 14:21, "And the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night." That east wind is moving again. It doesn't need permission. It just OPENS BASE COVENANT. FATHER, release that wind across nations, ACROSS OFFICES, ACROSS THE HEARTS of decision makers. Let papers move from bottom to top. Let files once forgotten reappear. Let visas, APPOINTMENTS, AND APPROVALS FLOW LIKE PARTED WATERS. Let destinies once stranded march forward on dry ground. Say it again with faith, "I walk on DRY GROUND. NO MORE SINKING. NO MORE DELAY. No more confusion." Psalm 66:6, "He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the flood on foot. There did we rejoice in him." The miracle of dry ground means progress without struggle. Where others drown, you advance. Where others sink in fear, you sing in faith. Father, we thank you because the dry ground of favor appears. Let every man and woman here enter their season of effortless progress. Let results appear without explanation. LET HELPERS SHOW UP UNANNOUNCED. Let speed overtake delay. Beloved, the Red Sea stood before people who had never seen a sea before. Sometimes God allows a new kind of challenge so he can reveal a new dimension of himself. Exodus 14:18, "The Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord." That means your battle is an announcement of his glory. Your story will make nations know that he still reigns. Say aloud, "My testimony will reveal his power. My turnaround will glorify his name." Now lift both hands. Father, arise as the God of Moses. Where there is chaos, bring calm. Where there is threat, bring triumph. Where there is opposition, bring overflow. Let every sea before your people recognize your voice. Let angels stand as walls of water until your sons and daughters have crossed to safety. Psalm 114:3, "The sea saw it and fled." Let every Red Sea that sees the covenant flee tonight. Flee from homes. Flee from destinies. FLEE FROM HEALTH. FLEE FROM FINANCES. Let impossibilities retreat at the sight of light. And now Father, breathe courage into hearts. Faith is rising again. The same spirit that parted the sea dwells within us. Romans 8:11, "But if the spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he shall also quicken your mortal bodies." That quickening spirit is awakening boldness. No more fear of pharaoh. No more fear of tomorrow. No more fear of failure. Declare with strength, "By the spirit of God, I cross over." By divine power, I advance. By covenant mercy, I survive what drowns others. Father, thank you for beginning this journey of deliverance. Thank you because the walls of water are already standing. Thank you because we are marching through on dry ground. We praise you for victories we haven't yet seen, but already believe. Psalm 34:1, "I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise shall continually be in my mouth." Our praise is the proof of faith. Our song is the prophecy of victory. And now we lift our hands and say, "God of Moses, arise and part every Red Sea before me. Let the heavens record it. Let the earth agree, and let hell retreat. thank you because the sea is already parting. Thank you because the rod of your power is stretched out in my favor." Exodus 14:15, "And the Lord said unto Moses, 'Wherefore criest thou unto me? Speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward.'" Forward, that is heaven's instruction. You have prayed long enough. Now it's time to move. Every barrier responds to motion backed by revelation. Therefore, decree, "By the word of the Lord, I move forward. By the hand of God, I advance. BY THE SPIRIT OF MIGHT, I break through resistance. Every Red Sea before me hears the command, part." Isaiah 45:2, "I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass." Father, go before your people again. Make crooked systems straight. Break gates of bureaucracy. Dismantle ancestral walls of delay. Beloved, when God of Moses arises, opposition becomes opportunity. Pharaoh pursued, but his pursuit was his destruction. Exodus 14:27, "And the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared." Let every adversary chasing destiny drown in their own plot. Let every plan formed in secret chambers turn on its makers. Father, release sudden deliverance. Let invisible chains fall from hands, minds, and finances. Let every addiction lose power. LET EVERY SICKNESS REVERSE INSTANTLY. Let the sound of freedom echo like thunder. Say aloud, I decree and declare, I AM FREE FROM EVERY CAPTIVITY. My family is free. My destiny is free. My generation is free. Psalm 107:14, He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and break their bonds in sunder. That breaking happens now. Bonds of fear, bonds of limitation, bonds of poverty, bonds of shame. Say, Father, I believe your word. You are the same God who brought Israel out with a mighty hand. Exodus 13:3, By strength of hand, the Lord brought you out from this place. That same strength is present now. The God of Moses has not retired. His outstretched arms still performs wonders. Father, we invoke the covenant of Exodus tonight. Every Pharaoh that said no to progress must bow to the name of the Lord. Every sea that mocked prophecy must give way. Every wall that stood before destiny must crumble. Psalm 114:5-7, What ailed thee, oh thou sea, that thou fleddest? Ye mountains that ye skipped like rams, tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord. Presence is the secret. When he appears, resistance disappears. Now decree it with conviction. By the presence of the almighty, every resistance around my life trembles. By the anointing of breakthrough, I walk through closed doors. By the voice of prophecy, I command impossible situations to bow. Father, speak once again as you did to Moses. One word from you divides oceans. One instruction changes history. Let that word locate your people now. Isaiah 45:2, I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. Go before us, oh Lord. Cut through barriers of men and spirits. Every gate that stood FOR YEARS MELTS BEFORE the fire of your presence. Beloved, every Red Sea has a pursuer behind and a promise ahead. When you feel surrounded, remember you are positioned for wonder. Exodus 14:19, And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them. And the pillar of the cloud went from before their face and stood behind them. The angel changed position to form a rear guard. God is still rearranging angels for your defense. So say it boldly, The pillar of fire stands between me and danger. The angel of the Lord stands behind me as defense. I am unreachable to evil. Psalm 34:7, The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and delivereth them. Encirclement means permanent security. Your life is surrounded. Now we attack delay. Father, every power that slowed men down, we command speed. Habakkuk 3:19, The Lord God is my strength and he will make my feet like hinds' feet and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. Let hinds' feet speed come upon businesses, ministries, and families. Let the anointing for acceleration cancel years of stagnation. Where men mocked, let sudden results silence them. Say it again. By divine speed, I overtake. By mercy, I recover. By grace, I excel. Father, release deliverance from inherited bondage. Every pattern that repeats disappointment, break. Every family altar that resists rising, SCATTER. EVERY COVENANT OF FAILURE, DISSOLVE BY THE BLOOD. Galatians 3:13-14, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles. Redemption cancels repetition. We exchange curses for blessing, stagnation for movement, shame for honor. Decree it. I am of the seed of Abraham. Therefore, I cannot be limited. Every border drawn by ancestral error is erased by the cross. Now the Lord says, Speak to the storm that mocks your peace. Mark 4:39, And he arose and rebuked the wind and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. So Father, we speak peace into chaos. Let winds of confusion settle. Let every voice of fear fall silent. Let anxious hearts find stillness. Beloved, you will no longer fear bad news. Psalm 112:7, He shall not be afraid of evil tidings. His heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord. Your heart is fixed. Confidence replaces panic. Assurance replaces anxiety. Now lift both hands and begin to command breakthroughs. I decree and declare, Doors open of their own accord. I decree and declare, Every pending approval is released. I decree and declare, Divine ideas attract divine investors. I DECREE AND DECLARE, HELP US REMEMBER my name. Daniel 2:2, He revealeth the deep and secret things. He knoweth what is in the darkness and the light dwelleth with him. Let secrets that hold wealth and influence be revealed to your spirit. Let the blueprint for next level advancement appear. Let understanding multiply influence. Father, we ask for VISIBLE RESULTS. NO MORE PROPHECIES without proof. No more prayers without performance. Psalm 90:16-17, Let thy work appear unto thy servants and thy glory unto their children. And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us. Let work appear. Tangible miracles. Undeniable interventions. DOORS MEN CANNOT CLOSE. Let the beauty of answered prayer rest upon your people. Say it aloud, My results will glorify God. My testimony will silence Pharaoh. My miracle will announce his power. Father, breathe upon every waiting heart. Where hope was dim, light it again. Romans 4:21, And being fully persuaded that what he had promised, he was able also to perform. Persuasion returns. Faith reignites. Celebration begins. Thank him now. Lord, thank you for deliverance from delay. Thank you for the east wind of progress. Thank you because the Red Sea is already parting. Psalm 126:2, Then was our mouth filled with laughter and our tongue with singing. That laughter begins tonight. Lift your voice in thanksgiving and say, Father, thank you for what you have begun in my life. Thank you because the same God who delivered Moses from Pharaoh is rewriting my story. Psalm 105:37, He brought them forth also with silver and gold and there was not one feeble person among their tribes. When God brings you out, he brings you out completely. Not half victory. NOT PARTIAL FREEDOM. TOTAL DELIVERANCE. FATHER, let complete deliverance come upon every family represented here. No member left behind. No destiny forgotten. NO CHILD SWALLOWED BY the sea of confusion. The God who delivered a nation overnight will deliver homes in this season. Now Father, we speak restoration. Joel 2:25, And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten. You are the God of recovery. Time lost in tears, restore. Resources wasted in battles, restore. Relationships broken by misunderstanding, RESTORE. HEALTH DAMAGED BY delay restore. CONFIDENCE STOLEN BY DISAPPOINTMENT RESTORE. Say it aloud with faith. GOD OF MOSES ARISE. Restore my wasted years. Restore my laughter. Restore my strength. Restore my place in destiny. The spirit of God says I am lifting forgotten men and women. People who thought time had passed them by get ready. Psalm 113:7-8. He raises up the poor out of the dust and lifted the needy out of the dunghill that he may set him with princes. Divine placement is happening now. Unknown names are being announced. Hidden gifts are finding expression. God is putting crowns where ashes once were. Father, let every destiny once buried under comparison and fear resurrect tonight. Let men and women rise into relevance again. Let doors long closed open with ease. Beloved, when God restores, he doesn't return what was lost. He multiplies it. Job 42:10. And the Lord turned the captivity of Job and gave him twice as much as he had before. That twice as much grace is resting upon you now. Expect double honor for shame. Double speed for delay. Double wisdom for confusion. Decree it now. By divine restoration, my destiny shines again. By mercy, I am 10 times better. By covenant, I recover all. Daniel 1:20. In all matters of wisdom and understanding, he found them 10 times better. Receive that dimension. Excellence becomes your new normal. Now Father, touch every home, every family represented. We command restoration of peace. Psalm 133:1. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. Unity returns. Arguments engineered by darkness dissolve. Love returns. Honor returns. Communication returns. The spirit of division is rebuked. We decree that every house becomes a bethel, an altar of God's presence. No more quarrels that open doors to affliction. No more bitterness that blocks blessing. The Red Sea between family members parts tonight. Let hearts reconcile. Let wounds heal. Let laughter fill the home again. Now lift your right hand and declare over your household, as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. No sickness, no premature death, no confusion will reign here. My family is marked for divine preservation. Joshua 24:15. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Let that statement echo as covenant over generations. Let children yet unborn enjoy the peace being established now. Let this prayer build an altar that speaks beyond decades. Father, heal the foundations of families. Every generational cause still echoing silence it by the blood. Every strange pattern be broken. Every embargo lifted. Psalm 11:3. If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do? But now we rebuild by revelation. Every faulty foundation of poverty, delay, or untimely death receives divine repair. Every altar calling your name backward is destroyed. By the covenant of redemption, we rise into new cycles of blessing. Say it again. My bloodline is blessed. My surname will not host shame. My children will not fight my battles. The spirit of the Lord says, tell my people I am turning bitter water sweet. Exodus 15:25. And he cried unto the Lord, and the Lord showed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet. That tree is the cross. Every bitter experience meets redemption tonight. Let memories that once caused pain now bring praise. Let what once broke you now build you. Let the lessons of the wilderness produce wisdom for dominion. Father, make the bitter experiences of your people springboards for glory. Let every scar become a testimony. Let every tear water a new harvest. Now we decree divine health. Exodus 15:26. For I am the Lord that healeth thee. That same voice that healed in the wilderness still heals today. Father, stretch your hand over bodies. Let migraines disappear. Let chronic diseases dissolve. Let internal pains cease. Let the spirit of infirmity depart. Let bones align, hearts stabilize, and blood be purified. Say aloud, I receive healing in my body. I receive strength in my spirit. I receive vitality in my mind. Psalm 107:20. He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their destructions. That word is working right now. And now Father, restore productivity. Genesis 26:12. Then Isaac sowed in that land and received in the same year an hundredfold. And the Lord blessed him. Let every labor begin to yield. Let ideas translate to income. Let proposals attract investors. Let gifts command reward. Let dormant potentials awaken. No more empty nets. No more fruitless toil. Luke 5:6. And when they had done this, they enclosed a great multitude of fishes. From this moment, your efforts will not waste. Decree it boldly. By the power of divine restoration, my hands are blessed. Whatever I touch prospers. Wherever I step, favor speaks. Father, we seal this atmosphere of restoration. No more Red Seas of delay between promise and manifestation. No more detours in destiny. Let the same God who parted the sea lead every listener into their promised land. Exodus 19:4. Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians and how I bear you on eagles' wings and brought you unto myself. Eagles' wings. Supernatural transport. From this night forward, move on wings of grace. Give him thanks. Say, Father, I believe restoration has begun. My family is healed. My destiny is restored. My celebration has come. Psalm 126:1. When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. You will dream new dreams of fulfillment and they will come true. Amen. Say, Father, you are faithful from age to age. [Music] The God who divided the sea for Moses divide impossibilities for me. Exodus 14:31. And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians. And the people feared the Lord and believed the Lord and his servant Moses. That same fear of the Lord, holy reverence, is rising again. Faith is returning to the hearts of men who thought it was over. Father, as you once caused your people to see your mighty hand, let your sons and daughters see tangible evidence of your mercy. Let the month ahead become an altar of proofs. Let healings, promotions, reconciliations, and divine surprises fill every day. The same rod that divided the sea becomes the symbol of victory again. Say it aloud, God of Moses arise for me. The Red Sea before me is parting now. Every Pharaoh pursuing me is drowning now. Father, arise as the man of war. Exodus 15:3. The Lord is a man of war. The Lord is his name. Let the battles of your people become victories of your name. Let unseen chains break. Let ancestral verdicts expire. Let satanic traffic be stopped. Where there was noise of war, let there be songs of triumph. Where there was panic, let there be praise. Psalm 118:14. The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation. Tonight, salvation becomes melody. Breakthrough becomes language. From now, your confessions will be thanksgiving, not complaint. Every why me turns into thank you, Lord. Hear this. The spirit of the Lord says, "I am rewriting timelines." Delays that lasted 10 years will collapse in one season. Missed opportunities are being recreated. Isaiah 66:9, "Shall I bring forth to the birth and not cause to bring forth?" saith the Lord. Every prophecy conceived in pain will deliver in joy. The travail is over, the birth begins. Decree, "By the mercy of God, I birth my promise. By the spirit of power, I enter my season. By the blood of the lamb, I end every delay." Now, Father, we pronounce victory over the nations and families represented here. Psalm 47:3, "He shall subdue the people under us and the nations under our feet." Subdue wicked systems, corrupt structures, demonic economies. Lift your people above manipulation, above fear, above lack. Let their names carry favor in places of authority. Let wisdom speak for them in boardrooms and altars alike. Say with faith, "By the hand of God, I rise above systems. By divine wisdom, I cannot be stranded. By the spirit OF EXCELLENCE, I SHINE in every land." Daniel 6:3, "Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes because an excellent spirit was in him." That same spirit now rest upon you. Excellence, favor, visibility. Father, we decree the silence of every accuser. Zechariah 3:2, "The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan." "Even the Lord that had chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee." Every accusation against progress rebuked. Every voice of condemnation silenced. Every record of failure deleted. The blood speaks louder. Say aloud, "The blood of Jesus speaks for me." Mercy instead of judgement. ACCEPTANCE INSTEAD OF REJECTION. FAVOR instead of disqualification. Revelation 12:11, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." Your testimony is your weapon. Speak it until mountains move. Now, Father, we release angelic intervention. Psalm 103:20, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Angels of deliverance, go forth. Angels of favor, locate your assignment. Angels of vengeance, enforce justice. Let there be supernatural alignment between heaven and earth concerning your people. And we decree, "From tonight, my life becomes an altar of angelic activity. Help us locate me without delay. Messages of good news find me swiftly." Father, thank you for the Red Seas already parted. Thank you for new beginnings. Psalm 40:2, "He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock." Feet on rock means stability. You will not return to instability. Your foundation is Christ. Your days of confusion end now. Say, "Lord, thank you for lifting me. Thank you for settling me. Thank you because I stand upon the rock of victory." And now, the final prophetic charge. By the authority of the risen Christ, I decree every Red Sea before me has parted. By covenant, I walk into my Canaan. By grace, I remain unmovable. By mercy, I remain sustained. Isaiah 43:19, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now, it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it?" The new thing begins tonight. New ideas, new relationships, new contracts, new songs, new fire. Old doors close. New realms open. The wilderness blooms again. Lift your hands in worship one final time. Father, receive all glory. You alone can divide seas, silence enemies, and rewrite destinies. We give you thanks for every life changed, every burden lifted, every testimony released. Let your presence abide continually. Let your spirit brood over every listener and every home. Psalm 115:1, "Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory." All glory, Lord, belongs to you. And now, we seal this service with faith. May the Lord bless you and keep you. May the light of his countenance shine upon you. May your path drip with abundance and your nights overflow with peace. May laughter return to your lips and rest to your soul. Go forth in victory. Go forth in dominion. Go forth in celebration. And the testimony will be this, "Surely, the Lord has parted my Red Sea." Amen. Amen. And amen.
